pages.title: All Conditions Match
pages.text: Every condition in a trigger must pass. Use target self for the skill owner, or target target for the event target. Action conditions use the entity selected for that action as their target.

pages.title: Health Fractions
pages.text: Choose health, target target, unit fraction, and max 0.3 to trigger against a victim at or below 30% health. Use target self for the player. Fractions always compare against that entity maximum health.

pages.title: Health Points
pages.text: Choose unit points for exact health. Ten points are five hearts. A min of 4 and max of 10 admits that inclusive range. Remove a bound with Reset when only the other bound is needed. After-hit health is used for hit and hurt checks.

pages.title: Keyword Presence
pages.text: Choose keyword, its definition ID, target, and min stacks. min 1 requires an existing application; min 0 with max 0 requires its absence. Both bounds are inclusive. Combine health and keyword checks to specialize a proc.

pages.title: An Interaction
pages.text: To require scorch before a lightning effect, add a keyword condition to the lightning action, select mastery:scorch, and use min 1. Follow with remove_keyword if the interaction consumes scorch. These are ordinary script fields, with no Java required.

pages.title: With Damage Type
pages.text: Add a Damage condition to hit, hurt, kill, or death. Categories selects melee, ranged, magic, physical, or elemental. Elements selects Mastery damage definitions or native schools, including slashing and piercing. Damage types and Damage tags use native registry IDs.

pages.title: Combining Filters
pages.text: Entries inside one list are alternatives. Each populated list must match. Categories melee plus Elements mastery:fire means melee with fire damage. Two Damage conditions can require both melee and magic. Combine these with health or keyword conditions. Empty lists add no restriction; one filter is required.

pages.title: Actual Damage
pages.text: Hit and hurt inspect all portions that actually dealt damage, once per attack. Canceled and immune portions do not qualify. Kill and death inspect the fatal portion. Equipment changes after impact do not change queued filters. Nearby action targets retain the original event damage filters.

pages.title: Magic and Keywords
pages.text: Native Iron schools count as magic and elemental. Extend magic classification through the mastery:is_magic damage-type tag. Periodic keyword ticks and stack threshold actions have no originating hit, so Damage conditions there do not pass. Use health or keyword checks instead.
